description: This file handles the merging of notes in a Git repository. It includes functions for initializing merge options, verifying file pairs, computing diff trees between commits, handling conflicts, and executing the notes merge or abort procedures.

methods.name: void init_notes_merge_options(struct repository * r,struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Initializes a notes_merge_options structure with default values and a reference to the repository.

methods.name: int path_to_oid(const char * path,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts a file path representing an object to its corresponding object id.

methods.name: int verify_notes_filepair(struct diff_filepair * p,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Verifies the status of a diff filepair and extracts the object id if applicable.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * find_notes_merge_pair_pos(struct notes_merge_pair * list,int len,struct object_id * obj,int insert_new,int * occupied)
methods.description: Finds or inserts a position for a notes_merge_pair within a sorted list based on object id.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * diff_tree_remote(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * remote,int * num_changes)
methods.description: Computes the diff between a base and remote object id, returning changed pairs.

methods.name: void diff_tree_local(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int len,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local)
methods.description: Computes the diff between a base and local object id, updating the list of changes.

methods.name: void check_notes_merge_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Ensures the notes merge worktree directory exists and is ready.

methods.name: void write_buf_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Writes a buffer containing an object to the notes merge worktree path.

methods.name: void write_note_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const struct object_id * note)
methods.description: Reads a note object and writes it to the worktree for merging.

methods.name: int ll_merge_in_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p)
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of note objects and writes the result to the worktree.

methods.name: int merge_one_change_manual(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Handles manual conflict resolution for a single note change.

methods.name: int merge_one_change(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Merges a single note change according to the selected strategy, handling conflicts.

methods.name: int merge_changes(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int * num_changes,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Merges a list of note changes, handling conflicts and applying resolutions.

methods.name: int merge_from_diffs(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local,const struct object_id * remote,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Performs a full merge between base, local, and remote notes states, returning conflicts and final state.

methods.name: int notes_merge(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * local_tree,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Main function to merge notes from local and remote refs into a final notes tree, handling conflicts and creating a merge commit.

methods.name: int notes_merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * partial_tree,struct commit * partial_commit,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Commits the result of a notes merge, utilizing the merge worktree and creating the final notes commit.

methods.name: int notes_merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge by removing the worktree files and cleaning up.
